run_pytee_cli: run the pytee script to duplicate stdin output to both stdout and stderr
review_pytee_main: review the pytee main block that reads stdin and writes to stdout and stderr
summarize_pytee_script: summarize the pytee script which acts as a tee utility duplicating input to two streams
test_pytee_stdin: test the pytee script by piping input and verifying both stdout and stderr receive the data
refactor_pytee_buffering: refactor the pytee main loop to use buffered reading instead of unbounded stdin reads
